title: Panels
description: Build and manage the project, system group, panel and cabinet hierarchy.

toast.moved: Moved. The QR code did not change.

archiveProject.title: Archive project “{name}”?
archiveProject.body: The project and its {groups, plural, one {# system group} other {# system groups}} and {panels, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}} are hidden from lists. Nothing is deleted.

archivePanel.title: Archive panel “{name}”?
archivePanel.body: Panel {tag} is hidden from lists. Its revisions and history are kept.

deleteGroup.title: Delete group “{name}”?
deleteGroup.body: The {panels, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}} in this group are not deleted; they move to “Unassigned”.

deleteCabinet.title: Delete cabinet “{name}”?
deleteCabinet.body: The cabinet record is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

tree.filter: Search tag, name, serial or code…
tree.emptyBody: The hierarchy is Project → System group → Panel → Cabinet. Create a project first, then add its groups and panels.

row.projectCounts: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} · {panels, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}}

cells.issuesAria: {count, plural, one {# open issue} other {# open issues}}, worst severity: {severity}

quickAdd.emptyGroup: No system groups yet. Add the first one.
quickAdd.emptyPanel: No panels yet. Add the first one.
quickAdd.keys: Enter: add · Shift+Enter: add and keep going · Esc: cancel

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick up, use Up/Down to choose a target, Space or Enter to drop, Escape to cancel.

moveDialog.helper: Moving never changes the QR code; printed labels stay valid.

detail.placeholder: Select an item in the tree to see and edit its details.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.description: After creating the project you can add system groups and panels from the tree.

form.createDescription: Only the name is required. Tag and serial are generated if left empty.
form.tagHint: Generated from the name if empty
form.serialHint: Generated if empty. It is the matching key when importing.
form.serialLocked: The serial number cannot be changed; it identifies the panel when importing.

table.search: Search tag, name, serial or project…
table.emptyBody: Add your first panel or import existing panels from Excel.

import.title: Import panels
import.description: Create or update panels in bulk from an Excel or CSV file.
import.formatRequired: Name and serial number are required on every row. Download the template for the other columns.
import.formatMatch: Rows are matched by serial number: an existing serial updates that panel, a new serial creates one.
import.formatLimits: Up to 5000 rows and 5 MB. A dry run comes first; nothing is saved yet.
import.fixErrors: Fix the errors in the file and upload it again to import.
import.moreRows: {count, plural, one {# more row is} other {# more rows are}} not shown.
import.success: {created, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}} created, {updated, plural, one {# panel} other {# panels}} updated.

errors.duplicate_serial_in_file: This serial number appears more than once in the file.
errors.project_required_for_group: A project is required when a system group is given.
